name: LicenseHub Pro: PHP + Preact license platform
description: Full-stack license management with Preact, PHP, MySQL, Stripe, strong authentication, optional 2FA, and GDPR-oriented flows.
longDescription: LicenseHub Pro pairs a Preact and TypeScript frontend with a PHP REST backend on MySQL. It covers secure authentication, payment-gated service creation with Stripe, full license lifecycle management, device binding, audit trails, and OpenAPI documentation. The backend enforces role separation, CSRF-aware sessions, and structured audit logs. Docker-oriented development and deployment paths are documented alongside config-driven behaviour. Automated tests support auth, payments, and API contracts.
features: OpenAPI as the machine-readable contract for integrators
Strong password hashing with optional two-factor authentication
CSRF protection, secure sessions, and rate limiting
Stripe checkout with refund and license state coordination
REST API with role separation and audit logging
Internationalized UI with light and dark themes
Device binding and machine verification for software licensing
highlights: Security-first defaults across auth, payments, and license APIs
Structured audit trail for accountability on privileged operations
Documented GDPR export and delete flows
challenges: Licensing platforms combine payments, cryptographic key hygiene, and abuse resistance.
solutions: Layered CSRF and session controls, idempotent Stripe webhooks, environment-only secrets, and automated tests on critical paths.
security: Strong password hashing with optional TOTP two-factor authentication
CSRF tokens on mutating requests and secure cookie flags in production
Stripe and webhook secrets only in environment configuration
Role-aware REST surface with audit logging for license operations
